name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.snkArcsM_cost
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (ids : List.{0} Nat),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.cost (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.snkArcsM g ids))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.snkArcsCL g ids)

source.code:
theorem snkArcsM_cost (ids : List ℕ) : (g.snkArcsM ids).cost = g.snkArcsCL ids := by
  simp only [snkArcsM, snkArcsCL, snkRawL, outNodes, xNode, yNode, bind_cost,
    tick_cost, idxOfM_val, idxOfM_cost, dedupM_cost]
  rw [mapM_val 1 _ (fun j => (2 * ids.getD j 0 + 1, g.netT)) (fun j => rfl),
    mapM_cost 1 _ (fun j => accessC ids j + (natC (ids.getD j 0) + g.netSC)) (fun j => by simp)]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc]

        (natC g.base.y +

            (2 +
              ((mapM 1
                    (fun j => do
                      let ij ← getDM ids j
                      tick (natC ij)
                      let t ← g.netTM
                      Pure.pure (2 * ij + 1, t))
                    ([List.idxOf (Node.src g.base.x) g.base.nodes, List.idxOf (Node.src g.base.y) g.base.nodes] ++
                      g.outs)).cost +
                dedupC
                  (mapM 1
                      (fun j => do
                        let ij ← getDM ids j
                        tick (natC ij)
                        let t ← g.netTM
                        Pure.pure (2 * ij + 1, t))
                      ([List.idxOf (Node.src g.base.x) g.base.nodes, List.idxOf (Node.src g.base.y) g.base.nodes] ++
                        g.outs)).val))))) =
    natC g.base.x + g.idxOfC (Node.src g.base.x) + natC g.base.y + g.idxOfC (Node.src g.base.y) + 2 +
        (List.map (fun j => 1 + accessC ids j + natC (ids.getD j 0) + g.netSC)
            ([List.idxOf (Node.src g.base.x) g.base.nodes, List.idxOf (Node.src g.base.y) g.base.nodes] ++
              g.outs)).sum +
      dedupC

          ([List.idxOf (Node.src g.base.x) g.base.nodes, List.idxOf (Node.src g.base.y) g.base.nodes] ++ g.outs))
